ycoss:1552.long_description: effective altruism — the use of high-quality evidence and careful reasoning to work out how to help others as much as possible. Its purpose is to help you figure out how you can do the most good. It will help you think about which cause to focus on and how to use your money or your time to start making a difference, right away.
ycoss:1552.metadata_document: The Centre for Effective Altruism is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Winter 2017 batch, in 2017. Its status is active. Its stage is early. Y Combinator lists its industry as Unspecified. Y Combinator source tags: Nonprofit. It is located in Oxford, England, United Kingdom. Listed regions: United Kingdom, Europe. Its team size is 15. It is a nonprofit. It launched in 2016.
